36080-a-fortunate-term.title: A Fortunate Term
36080-a-fortunate-term.creator: Angela Brazil
36080-a-fortunate-term.description: A book by Angela Brazil. There had never been a week of worse weather, even for Whinburn, and that was saying something! Mavis, sitting up in bed with a dressing-jacket and two shawls round her and three comfortable pillows tucked at her back, could just see out of the window if she craned her neck a little.

74306-life-in-the-eagle-s-nest.title: A Tale of Afghanistan.
74306-life-in-the-eagle-s-nest.creator: Unknown
74306-life-in-the-eagle-s-nest.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "The post-dák at last!" exclaimed Walter Gurney, springing to his feet, as, encompassed by a cloud of dust, the vehicle for which he had been watching appeared in the distance, the flourish of a horn announcing its approach. The youth had been reclining under the shade of a peepul tree, at the side of the road which led to a frontier station on the border line which divides India from the land of the Afghans.

arxiv-2303-14136.title: The Reconstruction of Constant Jerk Parameter with f(R,T) Gravity
arxiv-2303-14136.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . In this work, we have developed an FLRW type model of a universe which displays transition from deceleration in the past to the acceleration at the present. For this, we have considered field equations of f(R,T) gravity and have taken f ⁡ ( R , T ) = R + 2 ​ λ ​ T f(R,T)=R+2\lambda T , λ \lambda being an arbitrary constant.

arxiv-2308-13750.title: Quantifying and Documenting Inequity in PhD-granting Mathematical Sciences Departments in the United States
arxiv-2308-13750.creator: Ron Buckmire, Carrie Diaz Eaton, Joseph E. Hibdon, Jr, Jakini Kauba, Drew Lewis, Omayra Ortega, José L. Pabón, Rachel Roca, Andrés R. Vindas-Meléndez
arxiv-2308-13750.description: Abstract We provide an example of the application of quantitative techniques, tools, and topics from mathematics and data science to analyze the mathematics community itself in order to quantify and document inequity in our discipline. This work is a contribution to the new and growing interdisciplinary field recently termed “mathematics of Mathematics,” or “MetaMath.

arxiv-2405-01175.title: Uncertainty-aware self-training with expectation maximization basis transformation
arxiv-2405-01175.creator: Zijia Wang, Wenbin Yang, Zhisong Liu, Zhen Jia
arxiv-2405-01175.description: Abstract Self-training is a powerful approach to deep learning. The key process is to find a pseudo-label for modeling. However, previous self-training algorithms suffer from the over-confidence issue brought by the hard labels, even some confidence-related regularizers cannot comprehensively catch the uncertainty. Therefore, we propose a new self-training framework to combine uncertainty information of both model and dataset.

arxiv-2407-14733.title: Hard Prompts Made Interpretable: Sparse Entropy Regularization for Prompt Tuning with RL
arxiv-2407-14733.creator: Yunseon Choi, Sangmin Bae, Seonghyun Ban, Minchan Jeong, Chuheng Zhang, Lei Song, Li Zhao, Jiang Bian, Kee-Eung Kim, KAIST AI
arxiv-2407-14733.description: Abstract With the advent of foundation models, prompt tuning has positioned itself as an important technique for directing model behaviors and eliciting desired responses. Prompt tuning regards selecting appropriate keywords included into the input, thereby adapting to the downstream task without adjusting or fine-tuning the model parameters.

arxiv-2409-06826.title: Pattern formation of bulk-surface reaction-diffusion systems in a ball.
arxiv-2409-06826.creator: Edgardo Villar-Sepúlveda, Alan R. Champneys, Davide Cusseddu, Anotida Madzvamuse
arxiv-2409-06826.description: Abstract Weakly nonlinear amplitude equations are derived for the onset of spatially extended patterns on a general class of n n -component bulk-surface reaction-diffusion systems in a ball, under the assumption of linear kinetics in the bulk and coupling Robin-type boundary conditions .

arxiv-2409-09988.title: DNN-based ensemble singing voice synthesis with interactions between singers
arxiv-2409-09988.creator: Hiroaki Hyodo, Shinnosuke Takamichi, Tomohiko Nakamura, Junya Koguchi, Hiroshi Saruwatari
arxiv-2409-09988.description: Abstract We propose a singing voice synthesis (SVS) method for a more unified ensemble singing voice by modeling interactions between singers. Most existing SVS methods aim to synthesize a solo voice, and do not consider interactions between singers, i.e., adjusting one’s own voice to the others’ voices.

arxiv-2506-02594.title: EALG: Evolutionary Adversarial Generation of Language Model–Guided Generators for Combinatorial Optimization
arxiv-2506-02594.creator: Ruibo Duan, Yuxin Liu, Xinyao Dong, Chenglin Fan
arxiv-2506-02594.description: Abstract Generating challenging instances is crucial for the evaluation and advancement of combinatorial optimization solvers. In this work, we introduce EALG (Evolutionary Adversarial Generation of Language Model–Guided Generators), a novel framework that automates the co-evolution of optimization problem instances and their corresponding heuristic solvers using large language models (LLMs).

arxiv-2601-01638.title: Interaction Improvement
arxiv-2601-01638.creator: Adrienne Lancelot, Giulio Manzonetto, Guy McCusker, Gabriele Vanoni
arxiv-2601-01638.description: Abstract The relational semantics of linear logic is a powerful framework for defining resource-aware models of the λ \lambda -calculus. However, its quantitative aspects are not reflected in the preorders and equational theories induced by these models. Indeed, they can be characterized in terms of (in)equalities between Böhm trees up to extensionality, which are qualitative in nature.

pmc-11483924.title: A rising star involved in tumour immunity: Lactylation
pmc-11483924.creator: Xu Zhang, Changming Liang, Chengwei Wu, Senlin Wan, Lishuai Xu, Song Wang, Jiawei Wang, Xiaoxu Huang, Li Xu
pmc-11483924.description: In recent years, continuous exploration worldwide has revealed that some metabolites produced during cellular and tissue metabolism can act as signalling molecules to exert different effects on the human body. These metabolites may act as cofactors for proteases or as post‐translational modifications linked to proteins. Lactate, a traditional metabolite, is found at high levels in the tumour microenvironment (TME).

pmc-11512330.title: Prevalence of Antibodies against Adeno-Associated Viruses (AAVs) in Göttingen Minipigs and Its Implications for Gene Therapy and Xenotransplantation
pmc-11512330.creator: Kirsten Rosenmay Jacobsen, Javier Mota, Michelle Salerno, Alexis Willis, Dennis Pitts, Joachim Denner
pmc-11512330.description: Adeno-associated viruses (AAV) are widely used as delivery vectors in clinical trials for in vivo gene therapy due to their unique features. Göttingen minipigs are a well-established animal model for several diseases and can be used for the efficacy and safety testing of AAV-based gene therapy.

pmc-13048246.title: Nuclear translocation of β-catenin in Wg/Wnt signaling via the IFT-A microtubule–associated complex requires Pasovec/Gid8 proteins
pmc-13048246.creator: Linh T. Vuong, Marek Mlodzik
pmc-13048246.description: Wg/Wnt signaling is critical throughout development and homeostasis and associated with many diseases, including cancer. Wg/Wnt signaling is mediated by β-catenin (Armadillo/Arm in Drosophila) with the IFT-A/Kinesin2 complex promoting nuclear translocation of β-catenin/Arm. Existing information suggests that additional proteins are involved.

pmc-13185493.title: Soluble sugar component-based quality assessment and SWEET transport family identification uncovering soluble sugar accumulation mechanism in Zostera marina
pmc-13185493.creator: Meng Wu, YueChen Liu, HuiJiao Li, MengJiao Long, YaPing Gao, XianJun Fu, Lei Zhang
pmc-13185493.description: Zostera marina L. is a marine medicinal plant with important ecological functions and considerable medicinal value. However, the absence of a systematic quality evaluation system has limited the development and utilization of its medicinal resources. In addition, the molecular basis of soluble sugar accumulation and transport in Zostera marina remains poorly understood.

pmc-13274162.title: The C-type lectin AcCTL5 from Apis cerana mediates anti-Nosema ceranae defense via agglutination and hemolymph melanization
pmc-13274162.creator: Dufu Li, Tingyue Huang, Qianmin Hai, Qiang Ma, Xuelu Liu, Xiaoqun Dang, Zhengang Ma, Jinshan Xu, Zeyang Zhou
pmc-13274162.description: Unlike vertebrates, which use adaptive immunity, insects depend on humoral and cellular innate immunity to resist pathogens, with pattern recognition receptors (PRRs) like C-type lectins (CTLs) critical for recognizing pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs). CTLs are a diverse, mostly Ca2+-dependent glycoprotein superfamily defined by conserved Carbohydrate Recognition Domains (CRDs), enabling ligand binding and mediating immune defenses in invertebrates.
